question.text: For an open market buyback, when must the Letter of Offer be filed with SEBI?

answer.text: Within 5 working days of the Public Announcement
Within 2 working days from the record date
Within 15 working days from the board resolution

explanation.text: The Logic: Under the open market purchase method, the Letter of Offer is filed simultaneously with the Public Announcement (NISM-Series-IX workbook, p.222). The Trap: The "within five days" timing on p.222 relates to the draft Letter of Offer in a tender offer, and the "within 2 working days from the record date" timing on p.225 applies to the final Letter of Offer in a tender offer; neither is the open-market filing rule. Note: Read the simultaneous-filing rule directly from p.222 and keep the tender-offer timelines (five days on p.222, 2 working days on p.225) clearly separated.
